How to play

  1. Press a download button and save the file.
  2. Find the file you saved and double-click it. It opens in your web browser.
  3. Press Play, then create a world.

Good to know

Works in any modern web browser. Chrome gives the best mouse control.

You need an internet connection when the game starts, because it loads its 3D engine online.

Your worlds are saved in your browser on your own computer, so they stay private.

Works on computers, and on phones and tablets held sideways.
